Changelog

MicroFun 0.1.0

  • Support AST, LOG, LOGIT and NONE transformations in MaAsLin2 analyses and record the chosen scale in signed-effect plots.

  • Add mean-contribution top_n selection to taxon- and function-centered boxplots.

  • Display error-bar adjusted p-values in scientific notation and improve feature matching.

  • Improve Sankey spacing and automatic figure dimensions, and extend palette generation.

  • Update source author and maintainer information.

  • Hide Chord labels that do not fit the available arc. Static plots omit their callouts and legend aliases while the CSV retains the complete mapping.

  • Add a searchable, clickable HTML Chord legend. A selection highlights one sector on its actual track, including sectors whose labels are hidden.

  • Batch HTML pan and zoom by animation frame and reduce polygon sampling for HTML only. Chord associations and contribution widths are preserved.

  • The bundled PDAC workflow exports three Sankey variants and SDAA results for fun2tax. The tax2fun figure set remains available.

Additional included improvements

  • Unify signed visualization colours to honey yellow and sky blue, with plot-specific opacity and consistent two-group boxplot colours.
  • Infer plot classification ranks from analysis metadata; remove the hard-coded Genus dendrogram legend and reject conflicting explicit ranks.
  • Match tree Sankey node/taxon typography and show Taxon (rank) headings.
  • Label Chord functions as name[ID], remove Terminal label prefixes, and embed PDF fonts when Cairo is available.
  • Add fun2tax_chord, fun2tax_dendro and fun2tax_logfc; exercise both existing fun2tax Sankey tree modes.
  • Fix EC/MetaCyc reference IDs, ungrouped function boxplots, metadata conversion and zero-filled taxon/sample contributions.
  • Add reproducible Genus/Class visual examples and focused regression tests.
